SELECT T1.ORDER_ID bizCode, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T4.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T1.IS_NEED_SEND, T1.PAY_TYPE payType, DATE_FORMAT(T1.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') SETTLE_DATE, T1.SETTLE_AMT, T1.CCY, T3.ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T3.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T2.ACCT_NO recAcctNo, T2.ACCT_NAME recAcctName, T2.LARGE_PAYNO largePayNo, T1.SEND_STATUS sendStatus, T1.ORDER_STATUS orderStatus, T1.PURPOSE, T1.REMARK FROM STL_DVP_ORDERS T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON ((T1.PS = #{PS01} and T1.MY_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO) OR (T1.PS = #{PS02} and T1.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON ((T1.PS = #{PS02} and T1.MY_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO) OR (T1.PS = #{PS01} and T1.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN #{item}
AND instr(T1.ORDER_ID, #{bizCode}) > 0
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{payDateStart}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{payDateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND T1.SEND_STATUS = #{sendStatus}
AND T3.ACCT_NO like concat_ws('', '%', #{counterAcctNo}, '%')

SELECT T1.TRADE_ID bizCode, T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE, t2.PORTFOLIO_ID, t4.PORTFOLIO_NAME,
T3.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T3.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO recAcctNo, T2.ACCT_NAME recAcctName, T2.LARGE_PAYNO largePayNo,
t5.FINPROD_ID, t5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, IFNULL(T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T5.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, DATE_FORMAT(t1.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(t1.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') SETTLE_DATE, T1.TRADE_AMT, t1.CCY, T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO, T6.MY_ACCT_NO, SSAI.REGIST_ORG, case when t9.ORDER_ID is null then '${DISPOSE_STATUS_02}' else '${DISPOSE_STATUS_01}' end dealStatus FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T6 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T6.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO T7 ON T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T7.ACCT_NO AND T1.CCY = T7.CCY AND T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T7.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH T9 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T9.TRADE_ID and exists(select 1 from STL_DVP_ORDERS where T9.order_id=STL_DVP_ORDERS.order_id and (STL_DVP_ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS is null or STL_DVP_ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS!='02'))
LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SSAI ON SSAI.SEC_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID AND SSAI.TRD_ACCT_CCY = T1.CCY
LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON ((T6.PS = #{PS01} and T6.MY_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO) OR (T6.PS = #{PS02} and T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO =T2.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON ((T6.PS = #{PS02} and T6.MY_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO) OR (T6.PS = #{PS01} and T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO =T3.ACCT_NO))
WHERE T1.IS_CANCEL = #{NO} and t1.TRADE_STATUS=#{TS_01} AND (T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ( #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_09}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_10}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_74}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_75}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_20}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_19}) OR (T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN (#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_11}) AND T1.PS = #{T03}) OR (T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{F29}, #{F30})) )
AND SSAI.SEC_ACCT_SOURCE = #{ACCOUNT_SOURCE_01} AND SSAI.TRADE_PLACE = #{TRADE_PLACE_01} AND T6.IS_NEED_SEND = #{NO} AND SSAI.REGIST_ORG IN ('01', '02')
AND T2.PORTFOLIO_ID IN #{item}
AND instr(T5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, #{finprodMarketId}) > 0
AND instr(T1.TRADE_ID, #{bizCode}) > 0
AND SSAI.REGIST_ORG = #{acctType}
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDateStart}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN #{item}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH tt where tt.TRADE_ID = t1.TRADE_ID)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH tt where tt.TRADE_ID = t1.TRADE_ID)
AND T6.MY_ACCT_NO like concat_ws('', '%', #{counterAcctNo1}, '%')
UNION ALL
SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID bizCode, T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE, t1.PORTFOLIO_ID, t4.PORTFOLIO_NAME,
T3.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T3.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO recAcctNo, T2.ACCT_NAME recAcctName, T2.LARGE_PAYNO largePayNo,
t5.FINPROD_ID, t5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, IFNULL(T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T5.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, DATE_FORMAT(t1.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(t1.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') SETTLE_DATE, T1.TRADE_AMT, t1.CCY, T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO, T6.MY_ACCT_NO, SSAI.REGIST_ORG, case when t9.ORDER_ID is null then '${DISPOSE_STATUS_02}' else '${DISPOSE_STATUS_01}' end dealStatus FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T6 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T6.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO T7 ON T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T7.ACCT_NO AND T1.CCY = T7.CCY AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T7.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH T9 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T9.TRADE_ID and exists(select 1 from STL_DVP_ORDERS where T9.order_id=STL_DVP_ORDERS.order_id and (STL_DVP_ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS is null or STL_DVP_ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS!='02'))
LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SSAI ON SSAI.SEC_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID AND SSAI.TRD_ACCT_CCY = T1.CCY
LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON ((T6.PS = #{PS01} and T6.MY_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO) OR (T6.PS = #{PS02} and T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO =T2.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON ((T6.PS = #{PS02} and T6.MY_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO) OR (T6.PS = #{PS01} and T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO =T3.ACCT_NO))
WHERE T1.IS_CANCEL = #{NO} and t1.TRADE_STATUS=#{TS_01} AND SSAI.SEC_ACCT_SOURCE = #{ACCOUNT_SOURCE_01} AND SSAI.TRADE_PLACE = #{TRADE_PLACE_01} AND (T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN ( #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_76}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_77}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_52}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_51}) OR (T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{F29}, #{F30})) )
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN #{item}
AND instr(T5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, #{finprodMarketId}) > 0
AND instr(T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, #{bizCode}) > 0
AND SSAI.REGIST_ORG = #{acctType}
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDateStart}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND T1.SETTLE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE IN #{item}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH tt where tt.TRADE_ID = t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH tt where tt.TRADE_ID = t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID)
AND T6.MY_ACCT_NO like concat_ws('', '%',#{counterAcctNo1},'%')

SELECT T1.TRADE_ID bizCode, T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE, t2.PORTFOLIO_ID, t4.PORTFOLIO_NAME, t5.FINPROD_ID, t5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, IFNULL(T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T5.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, DATE_FORMAT(t1.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(t1.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') SETTLE_DATE, T1.TRADE_AMT, t1.CCY, T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO, T6.MY_ACCT_NO, T6.SETTLE_AMT, T6.PS , T7.ACCT_TYPE FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T6 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T6.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO T7 ON T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T7.ACCT_NO AND T1.CCY = T7.CCY AND T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T7.PORTFOLIO_ID
WHERE T1.TRADE_ID IN #{item}
WHERE T1.TRADE_ID IN (select TRADE_ID FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId})
UNION ALL
SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID bizCode, T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, t4.PORTFOLIO_NAME, t5.FINPROD_ID, t5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, IFNULL(T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T5.FINPROD_NAME) finprodName, DATE_FORMAT(t1.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(t1.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') SETTLE_DATE, T1.TRADE_AMT, t1.CCY, T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO, T6.MY_ACCT_NO, T6.SETTLE_AMT, T6.PS , T7.ACCT_TYPE FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T6 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T6.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO T7 ON T6.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T7.ACCT_NO AND T1.CCY = T7.CCY AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T7.PORTFOLIO_ID
WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IN #{item}
WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID IN (select TRADE_ID FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId})

SELECT T1.ORDER_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T4.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T1.IS_NEED_SEND, T1.SETTLE_DATE, T1.SETTLE_AMT, T1.CCY, T1.PAY_TYPE, T3.BUSI_ACCT_NO payAcctNo, T3.ACCT_NAME payAcctName, T3.BANK_DEP, T2.BUSI_ACCT_NO recAcctNo, T2.ACCT_NAME recAcctName, T2.LARGE_PAYNO largePayNo, T2.BANK_DEP recBankDep, T2.IN_OUT_BANK, T1.PURPOSE, T1.REMARK, T6.HI_USER operatorUser, DATE_FORMAT(T6.CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d HH24:mi:ss') operatorTime, T7.HI_USER checkUser, DATE_FORMAT(T7.CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d HH24:mi:ss') checkTime FROM STL_DVP_ORDERS T1 LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T2 ON ((T1.PS = #{PS01} and T1.MY_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO) OR (T1.PS = #{PS02} and T1.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T2.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON ((T1.PS = #{PS02} and T1.MY_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO) OR (T1.PS = #{PS01} and T1.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T3.ACCT_NO)) LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T4.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T5 ON T1.ORDER_ID = T5.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE T6 ON T5.SEQ_NO = T6.SEQ_NO AND T6.NODE_ID = #{TRADE_OPERATOR} LEFT JOIN SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE T7 ON T5.SEQ_NO = T7.SEQ_NO AND T7.NODE_ID = #{TRADE_CHECKER} WHERE T1.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE TT WHERE T5.SEQ_NO = TT.SEQ_NO AND TT.NODE_ID = #{TRADE_OPERATOR} AND TT.HIS_NO > T6.HIS_NO) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE TT WHERE T5.SEQ_NO = TT.SEQ_NO AND TT.NODE_ID = #{TRADE_CHECKER} AND TT.HIS_NO > T7.HIS_NO)
